scripts.text:
[Holink]
I am the meow~ Blacksmith Holink~
Master of refining, Holink~
I am the special cat Holink who learned from Morocc~
My daughter is so proud of me, Holink~
What should Holink~ refine today?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~我是铁匠霍林克~
精炼大师霍林克~
在梦罗克学艺的特别猫咪霍林克~
女儿最为我骄傲啦，霍林克~
今天让霍林克精炼什么喵~？

scripts.text: [Holink]
scripts.translation: [霍林克]

scripts.text:
[Holink]
My teacher Aragam said meow~
There's no cure for stupidity...
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
我的老师阿拉甘说过喵~
愚蠢是没药医的...

scripts.text:
[Holink]
There's nothing to see here, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
这里没什么好看的，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? What do you want me to do with this left hand...?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你想精炼左手上的什么东西...？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? What do you want me to do with this right hand...?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你想精炼右手上的什么东西...？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? You don't have anything on.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你身上什么都没穿。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Kyang~! Do not mess with my sensitive olfactory, meow~.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵呜~！别刺激我敏感的鼻子喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？饰品在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow? You talking about the other head parts, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵？你在说其他的头部装备，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Even Aragam can't refine such a thing, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
连阿拉甘都无法精炼这种东西，喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow~ Perfect refining. Did Aragam do this, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~完美的精炼。这是阿拉甘做的吗，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You have chosen an armor, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你选择了一件防具，喵~

scripts.text: [Holink]
scripts.translation: [霍林克]

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You have chosen an armor, meow~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你选择了一件防具，喵~
这次精炼需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny，喵~
要继续吗，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
A level 1 weapon...?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~

[Holink]
Meow, a level 2 weapon...?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~

[Holink]
Meow Meow~~ A level 3 weapon~~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵喵~~ 3级武器~~
这次精炼需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny，喵~
要继续吗，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Me-Meow!... A level 4 weapon...!
I've only seen it twice while
learning from Aragam... Me-Meow!!
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny for this refine, meow~
Want to continue, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵-喵！... 4级武器...！
我在跟阿拉甘学艺时只见过两次...喵-喵！！
这次精炼需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny，喵~
要继续吗，喵？~

scripts.text: Yes!!
scripts.translation: 是的！！

scripts.text: No!!

[Holink]
Kyack!!
You don't believe in refine master Holink, meow?~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵呜！！
你不相信精炼大师霍林克，喵？~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!!
Danger. Danger~
This weapon was refined a lot, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！危险，危险~
这把武器的精炼值已经很高了喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!!
This armor was already refined so many times, meow.
You might break it if you continue
to try refining this item further, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！这件防具的精炼值已经很高了，再继续可能会损毁喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You might break it if you continue
to try refining this item further, meow.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
再继续精炼，可能会损毁喵。

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Once the {0} is broken, you can
never use it again, meow. Not to mention... all current
^ff0000cards and enchantments will vanish for sure^000000.
You still want to try, meow~?
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
{0}一旦损毁，就再也不能用了喵。
而且^ff0000所有卡片和附魔都会消失^000000。
还要试吗喵~？

scripts.text: Yes, I do!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我要！！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow! Wise choice, meow.
But!!
I am not happy to see you doubting the refine master Holink, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵，明智的选择！
但是！！怀疑精炼大师霍林克，我可不高兴喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
You don't have the ingredients.
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny, meow~
Go get it, meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
你没有材料。
你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny，喵~
去弄来，喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
等一下...
你觉得我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Me~ Me~ Meow! Fun fun refining~
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~喵~喵！精炼真有趣喵~

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Perfect!! Perfect, meow!!
I am the disciple of the refining wizard Aragam~
Holink!!
Another day of successful refining, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
完美！！完美喵！！
我可是精炼奇才阿拉甘的弟子，霍林克！！
今天也精炼成功了喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meo~ Meow~ Kyaaak!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵~喵~喵呜！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow!! Aaaaakk~~!!!!
Kyaaak!! I have failed, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵！！啊啊啊~~！！！！
喵呜！！我失败了，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Holink]
......
......
All~ Everything~ Broken, meow...
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
...
...
全都~全都~坏掉了喵...

scripts.text:
[Holink]
Meow.... Master Aragam once said,
learn from your failures...
Human, this one failure will be the beginning of your success in the future.
scripts.translation:
[霍林克]
喵...阿拉甘老师说过，要从失败中学习...
人类，这一次失败，就是你今后成功的起点。
